title.zh: 教程：未开智物种已提升

excerpt.zh: 真是大获成功！那些原始的野兽已经提升到不那么原始的级别，成为我们蓬勃发展的帝国的人口了！
excerpt.en: A rousing success! The lowly beasts have been uplifted to become less lowly beasts, and are now proud citizens of our burgeoning empire.
